日文.首段: 高千穂鉄道TR-100形気動車 （たかちほてつどうTR-100がたきどうしゃ）は、1989年（平成元年）に5両が製造され、2005年（平成17年）の営業休止まで使用された高千穂鉄道の気動車である。本項ではTR-100形と同時に製造され、同じく営業休止まで使用された観光用の内装をもつ高千穂鉄道TR-200形気動車（たかちほてつどうTR-200がたきどうしゃ）についても併せて記載する。

章节.概要: 1989年（平成元年）4月に日本国有鉄道（国鉄）の特定地方交通線であった九州旅客鉄道（JR九州）高千穂線を第三セクターに転換して開業した高千穂鉄道が開業に際して準備した気動車7両で、一般用のTR-100形5両、観光用のTR-200形2両で構成される。いずれも新潟鐵工所製のNDCと呼ばれるレールバス型気動車の一種で、製造時期が近い松浦鉄道MR-100形、くま川鉄道KT-100形・KT-200形とほぼ同型である。TR-100形、TR-200形の車体、走行装置は同一である。エンジンは、新潟鐵工所製DMF13HSディーゼルエンジンを183 kW（250 PS）に設定して採用した。全車正面貫通式、両運転台、トイレなし、TR-100形はセミクロスシートで車体中央部に4人掛けボックスシート6組があり、TR-200形は観光用途の仕様で、全席ボックスシートである。各車両に愛称がつけられていた。2005年（平成17年）9月の台風による災害で高千穂鉄道全線が不通となり、復旧されることのないまま2008年（平成20年）12月までに全線が順次廃止され、TR-100形、TR-200形も用途廃止となった。TR-200形1両が阿佐海岸鉄道に譲渡されたほか、TR-100形3両、TR-200形1両が沿線で保存されている。
章节.車体:
新潟鐵工所の軽快気動車NDCの一種で、15.8 mの車体を採用した。当時のNDCの標準的仕様であり、製造時期が近い松浦鉄道MR-100形、くま川鉄道KT-100形・200形とほぼ同型である。TR-100形、TR-200形の車体構造は同一である。前面は貫通式、乗務員室は左側で、乗務員用扉は設けられていない。折り戸の客用扉が片側2か所、運転室がない側は車端に、運転室がある側は運転室小窓の直後に設けられた。扉間には上段固定、下段上昇の幅1,200 mmの窓7組が設けられた。運転台室がない側の扉と、客用窓の間に360 mm幅の小窓がある。全車トイレの装備はない。外部塗装は白をベースとし、雲海と川をアレンジした暖色系等のピンク、赤、紫の帯が窓下に巻かれた。

TR-100形はセミクロスシートで車体中央部に4人掛けボックスシートが通路の両側に3組ずつ1組分ずらして配置されている。TR-200形は全席クロスシートで、4人掛けボックスシート12組と、2人掛けシート2組が設けられた。全車ワンマン運転用の機器を備える。TR-200形客室内にはイベント対応としてビデオ、テレビとレーザーディスクによるカラオケ装置が設置された。
章节.走行装置: エンジンは、新潟鐵工所製DMF13HSディーゼルエンジンを1基搭載、定格出力183 kW（250 PS） / 1,900 rpmで使用された。動力は新潟コンバーター製TACN-22-1100液体変速機を介して2軸駆動の台車に伝達される。台車は上枕空気ばね、軸ばね式NP120D/Tが採用された。制動装置は機関・排気ブレーキ併用のDE1A自動空気ブレーキである。
章节.空調装置: 暖房装置はエンジン排熱を利用した温風式である。冷房装置は能力25.6 kW（22,000 kcal/h）のものが設置された。
章节.運用: 1989年（平成元年）4月28日にJR九州高千穂線延岡駅 - 高千穂駅間50.0 kmが第三セクター高千穂鉄道に移管されることに伴い、TR-100形5両、TR-200形2両が新潟鐵工所で製造された。移管にあたっては、延岡に地理的に近い自治体がバス転換を主張する一方、遠い自治体が鉄道存続を主張、宮崎県が仲裁して鉄道存続が決定している。開業にあたり、下り列車で20分、上り列車で10分の運転時間短縮、列車本数倍増、快速列車設定などの利便性向上策がとられた。1990年代中頃までは輸送人員は横ばいとなっていたが以降は減少に転じた。2005年（平成17年）9月6日に九州地方を襲った台風14号の影響で橋梁2箇所が流出するなど甚大な被害を受け列車運行を休止、部分復旧なども模索されたが実現せず、2008年（平成20年）12月までに全線が廃止された。運行休止時にはTR-102が延岡駅に、他6両が高千穂駅にあり、そのままの状態で保管されていたが、TR-201は阿佐海岸鉄道に無償譲渡されて同社のASA-300形ASA-301となり2020年11月まで運用されたほか、TR-104、TR-105は日之影町に譲渡され、日之影温泉駅跡で保存、TR-101、202は高千穂駅跡で保存され、不定期ではあるが運転体験が行われている。事前に予約すれば、随時運転体験が可能である。運転体験のメニューは高千穂あまてらす鉄道に問い合わせることで確認できる。TR-102は延岡駅で、TR-103は譲渡の話もあったものの実現せず、高千穂駅でそれぞれ2008年（平成20年）に解体されている。

中文.词条标题: 高千穗铁道TR-100型柴油动车组
中文.首段: 高千穗铁道TR-100型柴油动车组（たかちほてつどうTR-100がたきどうしゃ）是1989年（平成元年）制造5辆、使用至2005年（平成17年）营业休止的高千穗铁道的柴油动车组。本条目也一并记述与TR-100型同时制造、同样使用至营业休止的、具有观光用内饰的高千穗铁道TR-200型柴油动车组（たかちほてつどうTR-200がたきどうしゃ）。

章节.概要: 1989年（平成元年）4月，将原为日本国有铁道（国铁）特定地方交通线的九州旅客铁道（JR九州）高千穗线转为第三部门而开业的高千穗铁道，为开业准备了7辆柴油动车组，由一般用的TR-100型5辆、观光用的TR-200型2辆构成。均为新潟铁工所制造的被称为NDC的轨道巴士型柴油动车组的一种，与制造时期相近的松浦铁道MR-100型、熊川铁道KT-100型・KT-200型几乎同型。TR-100型、TR-200型的车体、走行装置相同。发动机采用新潟铁工所制DMF13HS柴油发动机，设定为183 kW（250 PS）。全车正面贯通式、双驾驶台、无厕所，TR-100型为半横排座席、车体中央部有6组4人用包厢座席，TR-200型为观光用途规格，全席包厢座席。各车辆都带有爱称。2005年（平成17年）9月因台风灾害导致高千穗铁道全线不通，在未修复的情况下于2008年（平成20年）12月前全线依次废止，TR-100型、TR-200型也随之用途废止。TR-200型1辆被让渡给阿佐海岸铁道，此外TR-100型3辆、TR-200型1辆在沿线保存。
章节.車体:
为新潟铁工所轻快柴油动车组NDC的一种，采用了15.8 m的车体。这是当时NDC的标准规格，与制造时期相近的松浦铁道MR-100型、熊川铁道KT-100型・200型几乎同型。TR-100型、TR-200型的车体结构相同。前面为贯通式，乘务员室在左侧，未设乘务员用门。折叠式客用门每侧2处，无驾驶室一侧设在车端，有驾驶室一侧设在驾驶室小窗正后方。门之间设有上段固定、下段上提的宽1,200 mm的车窗7组。无驾驶室一侧的门与客用窗之间有360 mm宽的小窗。全车不装备厕所。外部涂装以白色为基调，将云海与河流加以图案化的暖色系等粉色、红色、紫色色带卷绕在窗下。

TR-100型为半横排座席，车体中央部4人用包厢座席在通道两侧各配置3组、错开1组。TR-200型全席横排座席，设有4人用包厢座席12组和2人用座席2组。全车配备单人运转用设备。TR-200型客室内为配合活动设置了录像、电视和激光影碟的卡拉OK装置。
章节.走行装置: 发动机搭载1台新潟铁工所制DMF13HS柴油发动机，以额定输出183 kW（250 PS）/ 1,900 rpm使用。动力经由新潟Converter制TACN-22-1100液力变速机传递至2轴驱动的转向架。转向架采用上枕空气弹簧、轴弹簧式NP120D/T。制动装置为发动机・排气制动并用的DE1A自动空气制动。
章节.空調装置: 暖房装置为利用发动机排热的温风式。冷房装置设置了能力25.6 kW（22,000 kcal/h）的装置。
章节.運用: 1989年（平成元年）4月28日，随着JR九州高千穗线延冈站 - 高千穗站间50.0 km移管给第三部门高千穗铁道，TR-100型5辆、TR-200型2辆在新潟铁工所制造。在移管时，地理上接近延冈的地方政府主张转为巴士，而较远的地方政府主张保留铁道，宫崎县居中仲裁，决定保留铁道。开业时采取了将下行列车缩短20分钟、上行列车缩短10分钟运行时间、列车班次倍增、设置快速列车等便利性提升措施。到1990年代中期输送人员持平，此后转为减少。2005年（平成17年）9月6日袭击九州地区的台风14号造成2处桥梁被冲毁等严重灾害，列车运行休止，也曾摸索部分修复等，但未能实现，2008年（平成20年）12月前全线废止。运行休止时TR-102在延冈站，其余6辆在高千穗站，就这样被保管，TR-201无偿让渡给阿佐海岸铁道，成为该公司的ASA-300型ASA-301并运用至2020年11月，此外TR-104、TR-105让渡给日之影町，在日之影温泉站旧址保存，TR-101、202在高千穗站旧址保存，虽不定期但会进行驾驶体验。若事先预约，可随时进行驾驶体验。驾驶体验的菜单可向高千穗天照铁道咨询确认。TR-102在延冈站，TR-103虽有让渡的商谈但未能实现，均在高千穗站于2008年（平成20年）解体。

== 概要 ==

== 走行装置 ==
发动机搭载1台新潟铁工所制DMF13HS柴油发动机，以额定输出183 kW（250 PS）/ 1,900 rpm使用。动力经由新潟Converter制TACN-22-1100液力变速机传递至2轴驱动的转向架。转向架采用上枕空气弹簧、轴弹簧式NP120D/T。制动装置为发动机・排气制动并用的DE1A自动空气制动。

== 空调装置 ==
暖房装置为利用发动机排热的温风式。冷房装置设置了能力25.6 kW（22,000 kcal/h）的装置。

英文.词条标题: Takachiho Railway TR-100 series diesel car
英文.首段: The Takachiho Railway TR-100 series diesel car (Takachiho Tetsudō TR-100-gata kidōsha) is a diesel car of the Takachiho Railway, of which 5 cars were built in 1989 (Heisei 1) and which was used until the suspension of operations in 2005 (Heisei 17). This article also describes the Takachiho Railway TR-200 series diesel car (Takachiho Tetsudō TR-200-gata kidōsha), which was built at the same time as the TR-100 series and was likewise used until the suspension of operations and had a sightseeing interior.

章节.概要: In April 1989 (Heisei 1), when the JR Kyushu Takachiho Line, which had been a specified local transport line of the Japanese National Railways (JNR), was converted to a third-sector operator and opened as the Takachiho Railway, the company prepared 7 diesel cars for the opening, consisting of 5 general-use TR-100 series cars and 2 sightseeing-use TR-200 series cars. All are a type of railbus-style diesel car called NDC, made by Niigata Engineering, and are almost identical to the closely contemporaneous Matsuura Railway MR-100 series and Kumagawa Railway KT-100 and KT-200 series. The bodies and running gear of the TR-100 and TR-200 series are identical. The engine adopted was a Niigata Engineering DMF13HS diesel engine set to 183 kW (250 PS). All cars have a through front, two cabs, and no toilet; the TR-100 series has semi-cross seating with 6 groups of 4-person box seats in the center of the body, while the TR-200 series has a sightseeing-use specification with box seats throughout. Each car was given a nickname. In September 2005 (Heisei 17), a disaster caused by a typhoon left the entire Takachiho Railway line impassable, and without ever being restored the whole line was abolished in stages by December 2008 (Heisei 20), and the TR-100 and TR-200 series were also withdrawn from use. One TR-200 series car was transferred to the Asa Coast Railway, and in addition 3 TR-100 series cars and 1 TR-200 series car are preserved along the line.
章节.車体:
It is a type of Niigata Engineering lightweight diesel car NDC, adopting a 15.8 m body. This was the standard NDC specification of the time, and it is almost identical to the closely contemporaneous Matsuura Railway MR-100 series and Kumagawa Railway KT-100 and KT-200 series. The body structures of the TR-100 and TR-200 series are identical. The front is of through type, the crew compartment is on the left side, and no crew door is provided. There are two folding passenger doors per side; on the side without the cab they are at the car end, and on the side with the cab they are immediately behind the cab's small window. Between the doors, 7 sets of windows 1,200 mm wide with fixed upper sashes and raising lower sashes were provided. There is a 360 mm-wide small window between the door on the side without the cab and the passenger windows. No car is equipped with a toilet. The exterior livery is based on white, with bands of warm colors such as pink, red, and purple arranged from cloud seas and rivers wound below the windows.

The TR-100 series has semi-cross seating, with 4-person box seats in the center of the body arranged 3 groups on each side of the aisle, offset by one group. The TR-200 series has cross seating throughout, with 12 groups of 4-person box seats and 2 groups of 2-person seats. All cars are equipped with one-man operation equipment. In the passenger cabin of the TR-200 series, video, television, and laser-disc karaoke equipment were installed to support events.
章节.走行装置: The engine is a single Niigata Engineering DMF13HS diesel engine, used at a rated output of 183 kW (250 PS) / 1,900 rpm. Power is transmitted via a Niigata Converter TACN-22-1100 hydraulic transmission to two-axle-drive bogies. The bogies adopt upper bolster air springs and the axle-spring type NP120D/T. The braking system is the DE1A automatic air brake combined with engine and exhaust brakes.
章节.空調装置: The heating system is a warm-air type using engine exhaust heat. For cooling, a unit with a capacity of 25.6 kW (22,000 kcal/h) was installed.
章节.運用: On April 28, 1989 (Heisei 1), as the 50.0 km section of the JR Kyushu Takachiho Line between Nobeoka Station and Takachiho Station was transferred to the third-sector Takachiho Railway, 5 TR-100 series cars and 2 TR-200 series cars were built by Niigata Engineering. At the time of the transfer, municipalities geographically close to Nobeoka argued for conversion to buses, while distant municipalities argued for retaining the railway, and Miyazaki Prefecture mediated, deciding to retain the railway. For the opening, measures to improve convenience were taken, such as shortening running times by 20 minutes for down trains and 10 minutes for up trains, doubling the number of trains, and establishing rapid trains. Passenger numbers were flat until the mid-1990s but then turned to decline. On September 6, 2005 (Heisei 17), Typhoon No. 14 that struck the Kyushu region caused severe damage including the washing away of two bridges, and train operation was suspended; partial restoration was explored but not realized, and the entire line was abolished by December 2008 (Heisei 20). At the time of the suspension, TR-102 was at Nobeoka Station and the other 6 cars were at Takachiho Station, and they were stored as they were; TR-201 was transferred free of charge to the Asa Coast Railway, becoming that company's ASA-300 type ASA-301 and operated until November 2020; TR-104 and TR-105 were transferred to Hinokage Town and preserved at the former Hinokage-Onsen Station site; and TR-101 and TR-202 were preserved at the former Takachiho Station site, where driving experiences are held, though irregularly. If reserved in advance, driving experiences are available at any time. The menu of driving experiences can be confirmed by inquiring with the Takachiho Amaterasu Railway. TR-102 was at Nobeoka Station and TR-103, for which transfer talks existed but did not materialize, was at Takachiho Station; each was dismantled in 2008 (Heisei 20).

Takachiho Railway TR-100 series diesel car

The Takachiho Railway TR-100 series diesel car (Takachiho Tetsudō TR-100-gata kidōsha) is a diesel car of the Takachiho Railway, of which 5 cars were built in 1989 (Heisei 1) and which was used until the suspension of operations in 2005 (Heisei 17). This article also describes the Takachiho Railway TR-200 series diesel car (Takachiho Tetsudō TR-200-gata kidōsha), which was built at the same time as the TR-100 series and was likewise used until the suspension of operations and had a sightseeing interior.

== Overview ==
In April 1989 (Heisei 1), when the JR Kyushu Takachiho Line, which had been a specified local transport line of the Japanese National Railways (JNR), was converted to a third-sector operator and opened as the Takachiho Railway, the company prepared 7 diesel cars for the opening, consisting of 5 general-use TR-100 series cars and 2 sightseeing-use TR-200 series cars. All are a type of railbus-style diesel car called NDC, made by Niigata Engineering, and are almost identical to the closely contemporaneous Matsuura Railway MR-100 series and Kumagawa Railway KT-100 and KT-200 series. The bodies and running gear of the TR-100 and TR-200 series are identical. The engine adopted was a Niigata Engineering DMF13HS diesel engine set to 183 kW (250 PS). All cars have a through front, two cabs, and no toilet; the TR-100 series has semi-cross seating with 6 groups of 4-person box seats in the center of the body, while the TR-200 series has a sightseeing-use specification with box seats throughout. Each car was given a nickname. In September 2005 (Heisei 17), a disaster caused by a typhoon left the entire Takachiho Railway line impassable, and without ever being restored the whole line was abolished in stages by December 2008 (Heisei 20), and the TR-100 and TR-200 series were also withdrawn from use. One TR-200 series car was transferred to the Asa Coast Railway, and in addition 3 TR-100 series cars and 1 TR-200 series car are preserved along the line.

== Body ==
It is a type of Niigata Engineering lightweight diesel car NDC, adopting a 15.8 m body. This was the standard NDC specification of the time, and it is almost identical to the closely contemporaneous Matsuura Railway MR-100 series and Kumagawa Railway KT-100 and KT-200 series. The body structures of the TR-100 and TR-200 series are identical. The front is of through type, the crew compartment is on the left side, and no crew door is provided. There are two folding passenger doors per side; on the side without the cab they are at the car end, and on the side with the cab they are immediately behind the cab's small window. Between the doors, 7 sets of windows 1,200 mm wide with fixed upper sashes and raising lower sashes were provided. There is a 360 mm-wide small window between the door on the side without the cab and the passenger windows. No car is equipped with a toilet. The exterior livery is based on white, with bands of warm colors such as pink, red, and purple arranged from cloud seas and rivers wound below the windows.

The TR-100 series has semi-cross seating, with 4-person box seats in the center of the body arranged 3 groups on each side of the aisle, offset by one group. The TR-200 series has cross seating throughout, with 12 groups of 4-person box seats and 2 groups of 2-person seats. All cars are equipped with one-man operation equipment. In the passenger cabin of the TR-200 series, video, television, and laser-disc karaoke equipment were installed to support events.

== Running gear ==
The engine is a single Niigata Engineering DMF13HS diesel engine, used at a rated output of 183 kW (250 PS) / 1,900 rpm. Power is transmitted via a Niigata Converter TACN-22-1100 hydraulic transmission to two-axle-drive bogies. The bogies adopt upper bolster air springs and the axle-spring type NP120D/T. The braking system is the DE1A automatic air brake combined with engine and exhaust brakes.

== Air conditioning ==
The heating system is a warm-air type using engine exhaust heat. For cooling, a unit with a capacity of 25.6 kW (22,000 kcal/h) was installed.

== Car history ==
(no body)

== Operation ==
On April 28, 1989 (Heisei 1), as the 50.0 km section of the JR Kyushu Takachiho Line between Nobeoka Station and Takachiho Station was transferred to the third-sector Takachiho Railway, 5 TR-100 series cars and 2 TR-200 series cars were built by Niigata Engineering. At the time of the transfer, municipalities geographically close to Nobeoka argued for conversion to buses, while distant municipalities argued for retaining the railway, and Miyazaki Prefecture mediated, deciding to retain the railway. For the opening, measures to improve convenience were taken, such as shortening running times by 20 minutes for down trains and 10 minutes for up trains, doubling the number of trains, and establishing rapid trains. Passenger numbers were flat until the mid-1990s but then turned to decline. On September 6, 2005 (Heisei 17), Typhoon No. 14 that struck the Kyushu region caused severe damage including the washing away of two bridges, and train operation was suspended; partial restoration was explored but not realized, and the entire line was abolished by December 2008 (Heisei 20). At the time of the suspension, TR-102 was at Nobeoka Station and the other 6 cars were at Takachiho Station, and they were stored as they were; TR-201 was transferred free of charge to the Asa Coast Railway, becoming that company's ASA-300 type ASA-301 and operated until November 2020; TR-104 and TR-105 were transferred to Hinokage Town and preserved at the former Hinokage-Onsen Station site; and TR-101 and TR-202 were preserved at the former Takachiho Station site, where driving experiences are held, though irregularly. If reserved in advance, driving experiences are available at any time. The menu of driving experiences can be confirmed by inquiring with the Takachiho Amaterasu Railway. TR-102 was at Nobeoka Station and TR-103, for which transfer talks existed but did not materialize, was at Takachiho Station; each was dismantled in 2008 (Heisei 20).
